tha-ap264:1.1: Telamakkhiya.] Siddhatthamhi bhagavati nibbutamhi narāsabhe / bodhiyā vedikāyāhaṃ telaṃ makkhesiṃ tāvade. // //
tha-ap264:2.1: Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ telaṃ makkhayiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi makkhanāya idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap264:3.1: Catuvīse ito kappe Succhavi nāma khattiyo / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap264:5.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Telamakkhiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
